title: AI-assisted document drafting chat (ANDS dossier builder)
walkthrough:
You are inside a dossier's module workspace: a section tree on the left, a work panel in the centre, and a status rail. Opening a section shows an eyebrow line ("Module … · Section … · " then the section's applicability), the section title, its purpose, and a guidance box headed "What Health Canada needs here". A collapsed "Format & source" disclosure hides the format/bilingual chips and a "Health Canada guidance ↗" link. Below sits an action bar with tabs "⬆ Upload", "✦ Author in-app", and "⊘ Mark N/A".

Choosing "✦ Author in-app" on an AI-enabled section shows a second toggle: "💬 Draft with AI" (default) and "✦ Fill the form". In AI mode you read: "Chat with an AI assistant to draft this document — it will ask for any details it needs instead of leaving blanks. Nothing is saved until you click Use this draft. The saved draft is checked by ANDS Studio's structural completeness check (a technical checker modeled on HC criteria — not HC's official eValidator), and stays not-yet-filable until you review and confirm it." An empty thread reads "Tell it about the submission to get started — it knows what this section needs," naming the section by its title. You type into a box (placeholder "e.g. Sponsor is Acme Pharma Inc., contact regulatory@acme.example") and press "Send" (Enter also sends); the button reads "Thinking…" while the reply streams in as bubbles.

When a reply finishes, a "Use this draft →" button appears ("Saving…" while it works). Clicking it saves the latest AI reply as a draft. The saved document card shows the filename, size, a "fingerprint md5 …" label carrying the checksum's first eight characters, a "Download" link, and a provenance chip. The chip's tooltip states the draft was made under your direction and recorded in the audit trail, that your dossier text is sent to the configured AI provider for this draft only, isolated per sponsor, never shared across clients or used to train models, and that you must review and confirm it before filing.

Above the card sits a persistent, on-screen red banner: "⚠ Not yet filable — review required. This is an AI-assisted draft. It will not count as complete and the submission cannot be exported until you review it against the Health Canada guidance and attest it as your own content:" followed by a button "I have reviewed this AI draft — it is my content" ("Recording…" while saving). Until you click it, the section stays blocked and export is prevented; once confirmed the chip reads "AI-assisted · confirmed".

If the AI backend isn't configured, the chat shows a red notice: "AI drafting isn't set up yet (no GROQ_API_KEY). Switch to the "✦ Fill the form" tab above to author this section instead, or ask an admin to configure it."

The separate draft completeness check (elsewhere) names its profile and version on its face with the qualifier "(structural; not HC eValidator)", and states any md5 shown is document control, not validation.
